description: JPEG 2000 images (pdfnative 1.9.0 through pdfnative-mcp 1.8.0): mimeType 'image/jp2' accepts a JP2 file or a raw .j2k codestream and embeds it as /JPXDecode — passed through, never decoded, so a 24-bit photograph keeps its wavelet compression. JPEG 2000 is PDF 1.5: under pdfa1b the engine raises PDFA1_JPX_IMAGE (an error with strict:true); PDF/A-2 accepts it, as here, provided the image has 1, 3 or 4 colour channels and no opacity channel (PDFA_JPX_IMAGE otherwise). Replace <synthetic RGB JP2, base64> with your own JP2 bytes.

arguments.title: JPEG 2000 figure
arguments.caption: An RGB JPEG 2000 image, embedded without re-encoding.
